events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' on the world. A groundbreaking double LP that still sounds incredible today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost a true legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and showmanship remain unmatched. Forever Queen!

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The influential sixth studio album by The Beatles, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound. Still a masterpiece!

events.title: 46 years since the passing of John Lennon
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary 'Starman' David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. An artist who continually reinvented himself and left an indelible mark on music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. The King forever!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and songwriter, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped generations of rock music. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs' Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable voice of Madness! Still bringing the house down. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The British blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the one and only Paul Young! That voice is still pure gold.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Dolly Parton! A true queen of country and so much more. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and TV personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to West End hits, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the soulful voice of Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams, get into our cars... and onto our playlists!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction ceremony 38 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and The Beatles.

angles.name: Rock Hall First Class
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock history was made with the first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction! Who do you think should be inducted next?
